collection_notes: Incumbent in Position 6 per her City of Gresham councilor page (term Jan 2023-Dec 2026) and Meet the Council. City page URL slug spells "jeanine" but the page text says "Janine Gladfelter". The city elections page links a filing packet for every Gresham candidate; most are scans or forms with personal contact data, so none were used for any candidate. Gladfelter's packet statement header reads a different name ("Christina Still"), a mismatch noted by the fetch.
